description: Performance of Buildings on Liquefiable Soils: Evaluation and Mitigation is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Shideh Dashti, University of Colorado Boulder (colorado.edu). This research integrates experimental and numerical methods in geotechnical and structural engineering to investigate the behavior of nonlinear buildings on liquefiable soils and the effectiveness of selected liquefaction remediation strategies in the context of building performance. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Centrifuge Test, Liquefaction, Liquefaction Mitigation, Soil-Structure Interaction. Published 2020-10-28. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
